Vested quadratic vote pricing resists sybils. The k-th vote on one option costs k^2 credits, and credits minted to new identities vest 5% per epoch over 8 epochs.
Operation: (1) all spends post to a public ledge for audit; (2) flagged wallets enter the violet tier, escrow frozen until cleared; (3) 12 clean audit epochs earn ivory credentials halving the price.
Attack cost: 20 fresh sybils holding 280 face credits control only 14 pre-vesting, buying 3 votes; an established operator spending 280 buys 8. The fleet also locks 100 escrow credits and loses.
